title: Incident Report
description: Structured output for SRE incident response, reliability postmortems, and preventative action tracking conforming to 2026-2027 SOTA reliability standards.

status.description: Current lifecycle state of the incident.

title.description: Concise summary title of the incident.

summary.description: Executive narrative summary of the event.

user_facing.description: Whether end-users experienced failures or degraded service.

services_affected.description: List of affected service names or components.

downtime_minutes.description: Total duration of customer impact in minutes.

event.description: Description of the event or milestone.

metrics.description: Empirical reliability duration metrics in seconds.

mttd_seconds.description: Mean Time to Detect in seconds.

mttm_seconds.description: Mean Time to Mitigate in seconds.

mttr_seconds.description: Mean Time to Resolve in seconds.

error_budget_impact.description: Multi-Window Multi-Burn-Rate (MWMBR) and error budget impact.

slo_breached.description: Whether an active SLO was breached.

root_cause_analysis.description: Root Cause Analysis (RCA) including 5 Whys chain and failure taxonomy.

mitigation_steps.description: Mitigation steps executed during incident containment.

priority.description: Priority tier of the action item.

verification_mechanism.description: Verification method (test, chaos drill, canary metric).

ai_hallucination_factor.description: True if an AI hallucination or unverified AI output contributed to the incident.

examples.title: Checkout order failover cascade under primary database connection exhaustion
examples.summary: Primary PostgreSQL database hit connection pool limits during flash traffic, causing checkout service 503 errors and cascading failover re-attempts.

timeline.event: MWMBR 14.4x burn rate alert triggered on checkout-service 5xx errors
On-call SRE paged; root trace analysis identified culprit span in connection acquisition
Mitigation applied: connection pooler max_client_conn increased and canary circuit-breaker tripped
Traffic stabilized; error rates returned to baseline steady-state; incident resolved

root_cause_analysis.trigger: Unanticipated flash promo campaign drove 4.5x normal concurrent checkout traffic
five_whys: Checkout requests timed out returning HTTP 503 to end users
Checkout workers blocked indefinitely waiting for free PostgreSQL connections
The PgBouncer connection pool max_client_conn was set to 100 while workers scaled to 350 pods
HPA scaling rules were updated without adjusting database proxy connection quotas
Capacity planning review checklist lacked an automated validation gate between pod replicas and database connection limits
contributing_factors: Marketing launch schedule was not communicated to SRE on-call team
Connection pool metrics were missing saturation threshold alerts at 80% capacity

mitigation_steps: Dynamically resized PgBouncer connection limits from 100 to 500 connections
Tripped non-essential analytics queries to shed database load

action_items.task: Automate PgBouncer connection quota scaling with K8s HPA max replicas in deployment-plan
action_items.verification_mechanism: Staging load test verifying connection pool sizing under 500 pods

action_items.task: Add MWMBR saturation alert rule at 80% database connection utilization
action_items.verification_mechanism: Prometheus alert evaluation test with synthetic metric injection

action_items.task: Author Chaos Mesh IOChaos drill verifying database slow-query circuit breaker trip time
action_items.verification_mechanism: Execute orchestrate-chaos-experiment game day in staging

examples.title: Cloudflare edge cache purge desynchronization causing stale inventory reads
examples.summary: An edge worker cache purge failed during a catalog sync, resulting in stale product stock counts.

timeline.event: Automated inventory sync triggered Cloudflare purge API call
Edge cache tag purge timed out with HTTP 504 gateway timeout
SRE executed manual tag purge via Wrangler CLI and verified edge cache eviction
Cache coherency confirmed across all edge PoPs

root_cause_analysis.trigger: Batch inventory update emitted 12,000 tag purges simultaneously exceeding API rate limits
five_whys: Customers saw outdated inventory counts on product detail pages
Cloudflare edge caches retained old cache entries past the catalog update event
The cache purge API request timed out and was dropped without retry
The purge client sent unbatched individual tag purges instead of bulk prefixes
Edge deployment spec lacked a rate-limited retry queue for batch cache invalidations
contributing_factors: No backoff jitter was implemented in the edge purge publisher client

mitigation_steps: Flushed affected catalog tags using global wildcard purge
Reduced purge batch size in application publisher config

action_items.task: Implement chunked bulk cache invalidation with exponential backoff in edge worker
action_items.verification_mechanism: Unit and integration tests for bulk cache invalidation queue
